abstract: We report on one affected twin who presented with cough, dyspnoea and severe failure to thrive. He was found to have gross cardiomegaly on chest X-ray. This proved to be due to an intrapericardial teratoma with an associated pericardial effusion. The operation on this rare tumour was successful.
abstract_ja: 双生児の一人が咳嗽、呼吸困難、重度の発育不全を呈して来院した。胸部X線で著明な心拡大を認め、これは心膜液貯留を伴う心膜内奇形腫によるものと判明した。この稀な腫瘍に対する手術は成功した。
